_comment: AW-6 mechanical risk-path check. path_patterns are glob patterns matched against edited file paths; import_patterns are literal substrings matched against edited file content (e.g. an import line), per named high-risk area (TS-17). Empty per-area lists are expected until the matching app code exists beyond draft/ — add patterns as slices are built, review whenever a new high-risk area is named.

fractional-order-calculation.description: Fractional/lexicographic order key generation and comparison for drag-and-drop reordering

auth-allowlist.description: Cognito claim extraction, Saga membership/role checks, any write-authorization path

cross-slice-authorization.description: Any code that resolves or checks a box/content item's owning Saga across slice boundaries
